description: The file defines the HttpPublisherActor class, which is an Akka actor responsible for publishing messages to an HTTP endpoint in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages HTTP requests, responses, and acknowledgements, integrating with Ditto messaging and connection infrastructure.

classes.name: HttpPublisherActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for publishing messages over HTTP, managing request creation, response handling, acknowledgements, and connection failure detection within the Eclipse Ditto ecosystem.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Constructs an Akka HTTP HttpRequest from an ExternalMessage and target details, adding headers and payload.

methods.name: getHttpHeadersPair
methods.description: Extracts headers and content type from an ExternalMessage to prepare for request construction.

methods.name: handleQueueOfferResult
methods.description: Handles the result of offering a request to the Akka stream queue, completing or failing the associated future.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Callback to process HTTP responses asynchronously, invoking response handling logic.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a context object encapsulating the response handling logic for a particular request.

methods.name: toCommandResponseOrAcknowledgement
methods.description: Converts an HTTP response into a Ditto CommandResponse or Acknowledgement based on headers and content.

methods.name: validateLiveResponse
methods.description: Verifies that the live response from the server matches expectations, such as entity ID and correlation ID.

methods.name: toMessageCommandResponse
methods.description: Transforms JSON response into a specific MessageCommandResponse object.

methods.name: toCommandResponse
methods.description: Partially parses JSON to a CommandResponse, expecting a signal that can be cast.

methods.name: toConnectionFailure
methods.description: Creates a ConnectionFailure object based on stream termination info.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto-specific headers based on HTTP response headers.

methods.name: getPayloadAsBytes
methods.description: Returns the message payload as a byte array, depending on message type.

methods.name: getTextPayload
methods.description: Returns the message text payload as a string.

methods.name: getBytePayload
methods.description: Returns the message payload as a byte array.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Reads and converts the response body to JsonValue, handling JSON, binary, or text content types.

methods.name: stripUserInfo
methods.description: Removes user info from a URI.
